draft_en.subject: Industrial switches and converters under the SVP label - a second ODM source, EAC on your side
draft_en.body:
Hello SVP team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 26 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial switches and media converters sold under the SVP label next to your evacuation and alarm systems (E-link built today), a second ODM source in your packaging from small lots, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP, unmanaged - model STI-280GE - $46 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - STI-288GPM - $85.5; Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5. Racks, SFPs and EoC we do not carry; EAC stays on your side.

One question: which SKU family runs the highest volume for you - the unmanaged switch, the managed, or the converter?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
